coverageNotes: 2026-10-07 snapshot: the root supplement cross-checks 336 individual shop product records against the 4,688-handle current/discontinued TheCubicle public catalog; excluded products and reasons are in the handover audit.

All 43 original historical IDs are preserved. MoreTry X3 / X3+ and HaiTun V2 canonical records now name one specific configuration; mechanical, named edition and coating variants are separate records linked with familyId.

Every photographed record uses a URL actually returned by its own public product metadata or original HTML image element. Different colorways on the same model page remain selectable prices/variants rather than invented mechanisms.

Retailer Added is a listing date. Repeated 2018-09-11 migrations and Shopify published_at/created_at are not launch evidence. Unknown earliest dates remain unknown even for a documented commercial product.
Descriptions support editorial assessments, not personal testing or a community consensus. No universal performance score, corner-cutting angle or noise measurement has been invented.

This edition adds standard-cut picture/teaching/miniature and collectible 3×3 products in separate categories. Higher orders, mirror/fisher/gear/cuboid transformations, arbitrary one-off tuning services and unidentified cubes in jars remain outside the model archive.
The XiaWei Pineapple shop page expressly retracts its product announcement as a 2016 April Fools prank and is excluded. A product_type label alone does not establish a released cube.

Historical regional Rubik’s batches, unlabelled OEM molds, missing contemporary Chinese prices and unrecoverable early photos remain open research gaps; a blank annual row does not mean the maker released no product.

53 个五品牌商品逐条基于已缓存商品文案和结构化 Item Weight 修正；没有新增网络查询。消除 Maru 不可调磁误判、ES3 8磁页套用20磁/UV、MoreTry V2 文案误称V4、HaiTun V2家族最高配置混用、HuDong遗漏角轴磁力等问题。 / Corrected 53 products using existing cached descriptions and structured item-weight evidence, without new network research.

The Tingman, Olor and Tingboy setup products retain stock MoYu mechanisms and only specify shop lubrication/tensioning/accessories. They are excluded consistently with other pure setup services; Tingman Picture Cube and independently magnetized Cuber’s Home hardware remain recorded.
This research dataset is partitioned across historical.json, historical-brands.json, historical-collectibles.json. Source IDs and family relationships resolve across the combined catalog.

Round 3: checked all 14 Cube4You Tribox brand entries. Added Tile Matte/Glossy, two Maze recognition configurations and the independently documented 2010 Gas Assisted model. Recovered the standard C4Y product photograph and item dimensions/weight. Ordinary body colors, transparent sticker options, stands, bundles and other orders were not counted as independent new mechanisms.

Cube4You Chromium and Clear (Tribox 2363/2364) are Helicopter-derived edge-turning products, not standard six-face 3×3 cubes; excluded. C4Y Gas Assisted and Alpha V Feng YouTube oEmbed identify real historical reviews, but the exposed thumbnail endpoints returned HTML rather than images; those image gaps remain explicit.

V-CUBE: added the main 3×3 flat, 3b pillow, both keychain shapes and Magnetic. Official category body-color and DUO bundle entries are variants/bundles. This is international historical context, not an exhaustive inventory of regional V-Collections picture/licensed editions.

V-CUBE Magnetic is already advertised in the 2025 official catalog. Its 2026 catalog appearance does not prove a 2026 launch. Current official product-route failures and copied legacy specification-grid conflicts are recorded rather than silently combining different model facts.
